title: Your AI Consulting Growth System for Maritime Logistics Buyers

sections.label: 1 - GROWTH STRATEGY
sections.note: A clear growth strategy means one pain, one offer and one buyer in maritime logistics.

sections.label: 2 - MARKETING
sections.note: Marketing is outbound straight to maritime logistics companies. Each email talks about that company's own lanes and services, not AI in general.

sections.label: 3 - SALES PROCESS
sections.note: The sales process goes from reply to call to proposal without waiting days. The call puts a cost on their manual work, so the pilot price makes sense to them.

sections.label: 4 - DAY-TO-DAY OPERATIONS
sections.note: Day-to-day operations run on a weekly rhythm. Every Monday you know what was sent, who replied, what sold and what is being delivered.

sections.label: 5 - ONGOING BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
sections.note: Ongoing business development turns each pilot into proof and into a retainer. Every month the numbers decide which new opportunity comes next.

nodes.label: 1 - We start with one pain maritime logistics teams feel daily, like slow freight quotes.
2 - The first offer is a paid pilot that automates quoting or bill of lading data entry.
3 - The buyers are ops heads at freight forwarders, customs brokers and ship agents.
4 - Your monthly client target decides how many forwarders we email each week.
5 - Lead lists come from forwarder directories and LinkedIn, sorted by trade lanes.
6 - Claude reads each company's website and writes an email about their own lanes.
7 - Cold emails go out every weekday in Instantly from pre-warmed inboxes.
8 - Interested replies get two call times within the hour, and quiet ones get follow-ups.
9 - On the call we map their quoting or paperwork process and put a cost on it.
10 - The proposal goes out the same day with the pilot scope, the price and a start date.
11 - Every Monday we review emails sent, replies, calls booked, pilots sold and delivery.
12 - Each client gets one onboarding checklist and a weekly update until the pilot ships.
13 - Every finished pilot becomes a maritime case study with its before and after.
14 - Each month we turn pilots into retainers and pick the next segment to go after.

input_sample.trade_lanes: Asia to US East Coast, ocean FCL
input_sample.pain_seen: rate quotes built by hand from carrier emails and spreadsheets

output_sample.stage: pilot proposal sent the same day as the call
output_sample.pilot_scope: AI drafts rate quotes from carrier emails, a person approves each one
output_sample.monday_review_row: emails sent, replies, calls booked, pilots sold, delivery status
output_sample.after_pilot: case study written with the before and after, retainer offered
